results.description: CITY OF MINERAL WELLS, TEXAS VEHICLE AND EQUIPMENT LEASE-PURCHASE FINANCING The City of Mineral Wells, Texas, is requesting sealed proposals from qualified financial institutions to provide tax-exempt financing for vehicles and equipment with an estimated total cost of $554,598. The requested financing term is seven years. Proposals must be submitted in a sealed package clearly marked: "RFP 2026-009 - Vehicle and Equipment Financing" The sealed package must contain one electronic PDF copy of the proposal on a USB drive and must be delivered to: City of Mineral Wells - Finance Department 211 S.W. 1st Avenue Mineral Wells, Texas 76067 Proposals must be received no later than 2:00 p.m. Central Time on Friday, September 18, 2026. Proposals will be publicly opened at 2:30 p.m. Central Time on the same date. Late, faxed, emailed, or paper-only proposals will not be accepted. Questions and requests for the complete RFP should be directed in writing to Aaron Bovos at abovos@mineralwellstx.gov. The City of Mineral Wells reserves the right to reject any or all proposals, waive informalities, request additional information, negotiate terms, or cancel the solicitation when determined to be in the City's best interest.

results.title: Time to Jump-Start Congress
results.description: Another fortnight has come and gone—and not just any fortnight. Continuing a trend that began in 2015—and mirroring, in the political realm, the ratcheting up of global temperatures and resultant climatic catastrophes—this has been the 290th consecutive fortnight to have been worse than the one before. Appropriately, this one kicked off under cover of darkness. In the early morning hours of Saturday, August 8th, the full Senate voted, in effect, to combine the offices of Attorney General of the United States of America with that of Mr. Fixit of the Trump Organization. Equipment includes 15" Fuchs forged alloy wheels, disc brakes, RS-style door panels, lap and shoulder belts, and a digital AM/FM radio. This 912 coupe is now offered with a car cover and a clean Kentucky title in the seller's name.
